requirements.content: The ADC module shall provide a driver for analog-to-digital conversion measurements on the TMS570LC4357 MCU
The ADC module shall implement a state machine with three states: ADC_START_CONVERSION, ADC_WAIT_CONVERSION_FINISHED, and ADC_CONVERSION_FINISHED
The ADC_Control function shall control the ADC measurement sequence
The ADC shall use voltage reference high of 5000mV (ADC_VREFHIGH_mV)
The ADC shall use voltage reference low of 0mV (ADC_VREFLOW_mV)
The ADC shall support 12-bit conversion with a conversion factor of 4096
The ADC state machine shall trap on invalid state (FAS_ASSERT safety mechanism)
The SPI module shall provide headers for the driver for the SPI communication interface
The SPI_Initialize function shall initialize the SPI module using HAL functions and configure chip select setup for peripherals
The SPI_TransmitDummyByte function shall send a dummy byte to wake up the SPI interface
The SPI_TransmitData function shall transmit data on SPI without DMA in blocking mode with automatic chip select handling
The SPI_TransmitReceiveData function shall transmit and receive data on SPI without DMA in blocking mode with automatic chip select handling
The SPI_TransmitReceiveDataDma function shall transmit and receive data on SPI with DMA in blocking mode with automatic chip select handling
The SPI_Lock function shall lock SPI interfaces to prevent concurrent access
The SPI module shall support 5 SPI interfaces (SPI_NR_SPI_INTERFACES = 5)
SPI chip select shall support hardware and software modes (SPI_CHIP_SELECT_HARDWARE, SPI_CHIP_SELECT_SOFTWARE)
The SPI shall validate pSpiInterface is not NULL_PTR before transmission
The SPI shall validate pTxBuff is not NULL_PTR before transmission
The SPI shall validate frameLength is greater than 0 before transmission
The SPI shall validate string parameter is less than BS_NR_OF_STRINGS
The I2C module shall provide header for the driver for the I2C communication interface
The I2C_Initialize function shall initialize the I2C hardware with dedicated HAL functions before any other I2C API call
The I2C_Read function shall read from an I2C slave in blocking mode without writing register address first
The I2C_Write function shall write to an I2C slave in blocking mode without writing register address first
The I2C_ReadDma function shall read from an I2C slave using DMA
The I2C_WriteDma function shall write to an I2C slave using DMA
The I2C module shall use a timeout of 1000 microseconds to avoid infinite loops (I2C_TIMEOUT_us)
The I2C module shall use 2ms notification timeout for DMA transactions (I2C_NOTIFICATION_TIMEOUT_ms)
The DMA module shall provide headers for the driver for the DMA (Direct Memory Access) module
The DMA_Initialize function shall enable the DMA module and DMA streams
The DMA_IsTransmitOngoing function shall return true if SPI transmission is still ongoing, false otherwise
The DMA shall support 5 SPI interfaces for DMA (DMA_NUMBER_SPI_INTERFACES = 5)
The DMA shall map SPI1 TX to DMA_CH0 and SPI1 RX to DMA_CH1
The DMA shall support I2C1 and I2C2 channels (DMA_CH10-DMA_CH13)
The PWM module shall provide a PWM driver for the TMS570LC43xx using the ePWM hardware
The PWM_Initialize function shall initialize the ETPWM and the ECAP module
The PWM_StartPwm function shall start all configured ePWM channels after etpwmInit() is called
The PWM_StopPwm function shall stop all configured ePWM channels
The PWM_SetDutyCycle function shall set duty cycle in permill with out-of-range values limited to threshold values
The PWM_GetPwmData function shall return duty cycle and frequency of input PWM signal
The RTC module shall provide a driver for the NXP PCF2131 Real Time Clock over I2C
The RTC shall use I2C interface i2cREG1 with I2C address 0x53
The RTC_GetSystemTimeRtcFormat function shall return the RTC system timer value
The RTC_IncrementSystemTime function shall be called every millisecond from the 1ms task
The RTC_Initialize function shall return STD_OK when initialization is finished, STD_NOT_OK otherwise

The RTC shall implement initialization states: RTC_SET_SYSTEM_TIMER, RTC_SET_BATTERY_LOW_FLAG, RTC_CLEAR_OTPR, RTC_WAIT_CLEAR_OTPR, RTC_OTPR_CLEARED, RTC_SET_OTPR, RTC_WAIT_SET_OTPR, RTC_INIT_SET_FINISHED
The RTC shall allow maximum 1 second difference between RTC timer and IC time (RTC_MAX_DIFFERENCE_BETWEEN_TIMER_AND_IC_s)
The IO module shall provide a driver for the IO (Input/Output) control
The IO_SetPinDirectionToOutput function shall configure a pin as output by writing to the pin direction register
The IO_SetPinDirectionToInput function shall configure a pin as input by writing to the pin direction register
The IO_PinSet function shall set a pin high by writing to the pin output register
The IO_PinReset function shall set a pin low by writing to the pin output register
The IO_PinGet function shall return the state of a pin (STD_PIN_STATE_e)
The IO module shall validate pRegisterAddress is not NULL_PTR before operations
The IO module shall validate pin number is within MCU_LARGEST_PIN_NUMBER (31)
The LED module shall provide a debug LED driver that is directly connected to an MCU pin to indicate basic operation states
The LED shall indicate normal operation with 500ms on/off time (slow blinking pattern)
The LED shall indicate error state with 100ms on/off time (fast blinking pattern)
The LED_SetDebugLed function shall turn on the debug LED during startup before LED_SetToggleTime is called
The LED_Trigger function shall periodically toggle the debug LED at the frequency set by LED_SetToggleTime
The MCU module shall provide headers for the driver for the MCU (microcontroller) module
The MCU shall support a largest pin number of 31 for TMS570LC4357
The MCU ADC1 shall support maximum 32 channels
The MCU_Delay_us function shall provide blocking delay in microseconds using Free Running Counter 0 (FRC0)
The MCU_GetFreeRunningCount function shall return the current value of the Free Running Counter 0 (FRC0)
The MCU_IsTimeElapsed function shall check if a timeout in microseconds has elapsed since a given starting counter value
The interlock module shall provide a driver for the interlock circuit measuring relevant hardware signals
The interlock state machine shall have states: ILCK_STATEMACHINE_UNINITIALIZED, ILCK_STATEMACHINE_INITIALIZED, ILCK_STATEMACHINE_UNDEFINED
The ILCK_SetStateRequest function shall validate state requests and return result immediately
The ILCK_Trigger function shall be called time-triggered every 1ms
The interlock shall use diagnostic supply enable pin at position 30 (ILCK_INTERLOCK_CONTROL_PIN_IL_HS_ENABLE)
The interlock shall use feedback pin at position 29 (ILCK_INTERLOCK_FEEDBACK_PIN_IL_STATE)
The interlock shall use voltage divider factor of (5.6 + 3.9) / 3.9 for measuring interlock voltages
The interlock state machine shall trap on undefined state (FAS_ASSERT safety mechanism)
The interlock shall report feedback status to diagnostic handler (DIAG_ID_INTERLOCK_FEEDBACK)
The FRAM module shall provide a driver for FRAM (Ferroelectric RAM) non-volatile memory
The FRAM_Initialize function shall initialize addresses to be written in FRAM before any use
The FRAM_WriteData function shall write a variable to FRAM corresponding to the block ID
The FRAM_ReadData function shall read a variable from FRAM corresponding to the block ID
The FRAM shall return FRAM_ACCESS_OK, FRAM_ACCESS_SPI_BUSY, FRAM_ACCESS_CRC_BUSY, or FRAM_ACCESS_CRC_ERROR status
The FRAM shall store VERSION, SOC, SBC_INIT_STATE, DEEP_DISCHARGE_FLAG, SOE, SYS_MON_RECORD, and INSULATION_FLAG blocks
The FRAM shall use 8-byte CRC header for data integrity (FRAM_CRC_HEADER_SIZE)
The foxmath module shall provide math library for often used math functions including slope and linear interpolation
The MATH_StartupSelfTest function shall provide self-test for math functions that can be called at startup
The MATH_LinearInterpolation function shall linearly inter-/extrapolate a third point according to two given points
The MATH_AbsInt32_t function shall return absolute value or INT32_MAX if INT32_MIN is passed
The checksum module shall provide checksum validation functionality
The CHK_ValidateChecksum function shall validate checksum and return STD_RETURN_TYPE_e
The CRC module shall use the system CRC hardware for data integrity calculation
The CRC shall use seed value 0xBADC0DED (high) and 0xDEADBEEF (low) for CRC calculation
The CRC_CalculateCrc function shall compute CRC of data flow using MCU hardware with byte chunks
The PEX module shall provide a driver for the NXP PCA9539 port expander module
The PEX shall support 3 port expanders (PEX_NR_OF_PORT_EXPANDERS = 3)
The PEX_Initialize function shall initialize local variable containing state of port expander
The PEX_SetPin function shall set a port expander pin to high
The PEX_ResetPin function shall set a port expander pin to low
The PEX_Trigger function shall implement reading/writing to port expander registers via I2C
The PHY module shall provide configuration for the PHY layer including address and timing settings
The PHY shall use address 1 (PHY_ADDRESS)
The PHY shall require at least 720ns for hardware reset (PHY_HW_RESET_TIME = 1)
The PHY auto-negotiation delay shall be 100 time units (PHY_AUTO_NEG_DELAY_TIME)
The MEAS module shall provide driver for measurements needed by the BMS (current, voltage, temperature)
The MEAS_Initialize function shall call all initialization functions
The MEAS_Control function shall be called from the task every 1ms
The MEAS_IsFirstMeasurementCycleFinished function shall check if the first AFE measurement cycle was completed
The MEAS_RequestOpenWireCheck function shall make request to AFE state machine to perform open-wire check
The HTSEN module shall provide a driver for the Sensirion SHT35-DIS I2C humidity/temperature sensor
The HTSEN state machine shall have states: HTSEN_START_MEAS, HTSEN_READ_RESULTS
The HTSEN_Trigger function shall step through the state machine that handles I2C sensor measurement
The SPS module shall provide headers for the driver for smart power switches
The SPS_Initialize function shall initialize IOs for the SPS driver including register configuration
The SPS_Ctrl function shall be called time-triggered every 10ms and must not be re-entrant
The SPS_RequestContactorState function shall request contactor state for channels affiliated with SPS_AFF_CONTACTOR
The SPS_GetChannelCurrentFeedback function shall compare measured current with threshold to determine contactor state
Each SPS IC shall have 4 outputs (SPS_NR_CONTACTOR_PER_IC = 4)
The SPS shall use 2 ICs in daisy-chain (SPS_NR_OF_IC = 2)
The SPS current measurement LSB shall be 0.98mA (SPS_I_MEASUREMENT_LSB_mA)
The SPS shall recognize contactor as closed when current exceeds 20mA threshold (SPS_CHANNEL_ON_DEFAULT_THRESHOLD_mA)
The SPS state machine shall have states: SPS_START, SPS_RESET_LOW, SPS_RESET_HIGH, SPS_CONFIGURE_CONTROL_REGISTER, SPS_TRIGGER_CURRENT_MEASUREMENT, SPS_READ_MEASURED_CURRENT1-4, SPS_READ_EN_IRQ_PIN
The SPS shall validate channelIndex is less than SPS_NR_OF_AVAILABLE_SPS_CHANNELS
The SPS shall validate channelFunction is either SPS_CHANNEL_OFF or SPS_CHANNEL_ON
The SPS channel affiliation types shall be SPS_AFF_CONTACTOR or SPS_AFF_GENERAL_IO
The contactor module shall provide headers for the driver for contactors
The CONT_GetContactorState function shall return the current contactor state from CONT_ELECTRICAL_STATE_TYPE_e
The CONT_OpenContactor function shall make an open state request to the specific contactor
The CONT_CloseContactor function shall make a close state request to the specific contactor
The CONT_OpenAllContactors function shall open all contactors
The CONT_CheckFeedback function shall make a DIAG entry for each contactor when feedback does not match set value
The contactor states shall be CONT_SWITCH_OFF (open), CONT_SWITCH_ON (closed), CONT_SWITCH_UNDEFINED
The contactor feedback types shall be CONT_FEEDBACK_NORMALLY_OPEN, CONT_FEEDBACK_NORMALLY_CLOSED, CONT_FEEDBACK_THROUGH_CURRENT, CONT_HAS_NO_FEEDBACK
The contactor types shall be CONT_PLUS (HV plus path), CONT_MINUS (HV minus path), CONT_PRECHARGE, CONT_UNDEFINED
The contactor shall validate stringNumber is less than BS_NR_OF_STRINGS
The contactor shall validate contactor type is not CONT_UNDEFINED
The contactor shall validate SPS channel is less than SPS_NR_OF_AVAILABLE_SPS_CHANNELS
The contactor shall validate channel affiliation is SPS_AFF_CONTACTOR
The contactor state machine shall trap on undefined contactor type (FAS_TRAP)
The CAN module shall provide header for the driver for the CAN communication interface
The CAN shall support 64 message boxes (CAN_TOTAL_NUMBER_OF_MESSAGE_BOXES) for TMS570LC4357
The CAN shall define 32 TX message boxes (CAN_NR_OF_TX_MESSAGE_BOX) out of 64 total
The CAN TX function shall be called in 10ms task time slot (CAN_TICK_ms)
The CAN_DataSend function shall send data over CAN by marking message boxes for transmission
The CAN_MainFunction shall perform CAN timing checks and send periodic messages
The CAN_ReadRxBuffer shall check received data from buffer because CAN frames are received in interrupt routine
The CAN_Initialize function shall enable the CAN transceiver before using CAN interface
The CAN_EnablePeriodic function shall enable/disable periodic sending to prevent sending uninitialized data
The CAN_IsCurrentSensorPresent function shall return presence flag for current sensor
